limits: Straight-line distances, not walking or travel times.
Resale data from data.gov.sg (HDB), Jan 2017 to 2026-10; the newest month may be incomplete. Not a valuation.

MOP is 5 years from key collection for standard flats. We only know each block's lease start year, so this status is approximate (a block can reach MOP months earlier or later). Plus and Prime flats have a 10-year MOP; the data cannot identify them, and none has been resold yet. Blocks with no resale yet are not shown. Check HDB for a specific flat.
School registration distance (1 km / 2 km) is measured by MOE with OneMap, not by us; check it there.
card.storey_prices_limits: Recorded resale medians by storey band over the last 24 months of data; only bands with at least 5 sales. All flat types pooled; size, type and condition differ. Wider storey ranges are omitted. No unit-level price or facing; not a valuation or a forecast.

limits: Straight-line distances from our coordinates, not MOE's measurement.

When a school has more applicants than places in the later registration phases, MOE ranks them by citizenship and then by distance (within 1 km, then 1 to 2 km, then beyond 2 km), measured from the school boundary to the home address, so the bands here are approximate. A child can apply to any school; being nearby does not guarantee a place. Check MOE's P1 registration page and OneMap before relying on this.
Borderline: just over 2 km by our point, which may fall within 2 km of the school boundary.
